label: batch-3
tail:
Steps 1–2 complete for batch 3. Four artifacts written, nothing else touched.

## Scaffold

`finite-fields-and-cyclotomic-extensions` (A, order 101.2) — **46 items**; companion (B, 101.4) — **19**. Under the 60 ceiling, so no split. Design estimated A 44 / B 17.

Shape: Galois theory of finite fields (Frobenius, the intermediate-field lattice, the conjugate description, the divisor-sum identity) → the normal basis theorem in both cases → μₙ(K) and separability of tⁿ−1 → cyclotomic extensions and the embedding into (ℤ/n)ˣ → Φₙ over ℤ by the divisor recursion, its roots, its irreducibility over ℚ, its factorisation over 𝔽_q → composita, intersections, infinitely many primes ≡1 mod n, every finite abelian group as a Galois group over ℚ.

## Findings for the step-3 Alpha (full text in `research/frontier-18-batch-3.notes.md` §7)

- **F1 — spec edit needed.** The normal basis theorem's finite-base case needs `thm-cyclic-vector-criterion-by-minimal-and-characteristic-polynomials`, homed on `triangularisation-and-jordan-canonical-form` (order 90), which is **not** in the closure of the spec's `requires`. My manifest declares the edge, so `splice-plan.mjs` will refuse the batch until this is adjudicated — the designed channel, and the design already called this edge "the one that would be missed".
- **F2 — `the-galois-correspondence` is `status: draft`**, all 30 items, committed by frontier-17. I cite 16 of them across 30 edges. `depsource` will report `draft-page`, which it does not fail. No alternative supplier exists; publication order is an owner matter.
- **F3 — five results the GA-3 design lists are already published on AA-15** (subfield criterion, the x^{qⁿ}−x factorisation, existence of an irreducible of every degree, the 𝔽₄/𝔽₈/𝔽₉ presentations, `fs-f-p-n-is-z-mod-p-n`). None re-minted; a dictionary remark records the lattice agreement.
- **F4 — Kronecker–Weber has no proof route here.** Milne states it in a footnote and proves it nowhere; Conrad calls it deep. Minted as `rem-kronecker-weber`, `proved_here: false`, with the full external-dependency record; the provable converse is built separately.
- **F8 — the design's cited support for the infinite-field normal basis cannot be used.** `cor-polynomials-over-an-infinite-domain-are-determined-by-values` is single-variable *and* `ai-generated`, so it is an illegal deps target. Replaced by a locally built several-variable lemma (Clark 8.21 / Milne 5.19).
- F5, F6, F7, F9, F10, F11 cover the quadratic-subfield item becoming a generated corollary, two added Clark applications, two group-theory prerequisites the library lacks, two 𝔽_p→𝔽_q generalisations, the Φₙ definition, and keeping the intersection theorem restricted to ℚ.

Seven applyable amendments to `research/plan-algebra-track.md` §II.2 are in §4 with exact old/new text. Design-vs-spec `requires` drift is recorded in §3 and left to stage 1's `drift` unit.

## Gates

Green: `content-policy --manifest-only` (65 items), `coverage-checklist --require-destination` (204 harvested rows, 6 sources), `source-fetch-check --stamp` (6/6), `url-sweep --recover --fail-on-dead` (6/6 live), `source-backing` (52 results backed), `boundary-audit` (464 rows, no template reuse, no contradictions), `manifest-integrity`, `prosecheck` (0 errors; 34 count warnings, all in the report sections the brief requires counts in).

Not clean, honestly: `finite-smoke` reports 11 `item-missing` errors — expected, the items don't exist yet. The line that matters is **10/58 items carrying obligations**.

Not run: `validate-plan.mjs` and `depsource.mjs`, because my items aren't spliced until step 4. I reimplemented their checks against my own manifest and all pass — that is not a gate passing. Expected at step 4: validate-plan clean iff F1 is applied, otherwise one `undeclared-prereq`; depsource 0 unresolved, 0 planned-later, 30 `draft-page`.

Confidence and what I did not verify are in §12 — chiefly the Φ₁₀₅ coefficient (taken from Conrad, not recomputed), the invertibility route in the conjugate-matrix lemma, and the harvest rows dispositioned from a heading rather than a proof.
